_comment: Starter evaluation set (Phase 6). Expand over time with your own questions and expected_keywords from domain knowledge — do not inflate this file artificially.

questions.question: What are the main benefits of using SQLite for local desktop applications?
questions.notes: Should mention zero-config / serverless / single-file storage for desktop apps.

questions.question: What is WAL mode in SQLite and why is it used?
questions.notes: Web search should retrieve SQLite docs or articles explaining WAL journaling.

questions.question: Why do mobile applications commonly use embedded databases like SQLite?
questions.notes: Should cover offline/local storage benefits on device.

questions.question: What is the Nimbus Cache project codename and how quickly can it rebuild indexes after a power brownout?
questions.notes: Should hit uploaded testdata/aurora_notes.txt in the Knowledge Base (RAG), not only the web.

questions.question: When the Aurora constellation enables store-and-forward mode, how do packet loss and latency change?
questions.notes: KB-only: specific numbers from aurora_notes.txt (4.2% -> 0.8%, latency ~2.5s).

questions.question: What is ChromaDB and how is it used for local vector search?
questions.notes: Web search question about vector stores; no KB doc required.

questions.question: How does the Aurora satellite constellation use SQLite for offline sensor storage?
questions.notes: Mixed: KB has Aurora+SQLite details; web may add general context.
